info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Settlement Processing API
info.description: The Settlement Processing API allows users to initiate the processing of a specific settlement by providing its unique settlement ID. This endpoint is essential for financial institutions and organizations looking to efficiently manage settlement workflows. Typical consumers include payment processors and financial services applications that require real-time settlement updates. Using this API, developers can automate settlement operations, ensuring timely updates and improved transaction handling.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to process the settlement identified by RES-100045. It performs the necessary actions to finalize the transaction associated with this settlement.
